subject: MAP: Aligning procurement sign-off & target close for Q3 deployment
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Miller <s.miller@acmeind.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Aug 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: Aligning procurement sign-off & target close for Q3 deployment

Hi Sophie — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and a proposed Mutual Action Plan (MAP) so we have the same critical path to close. I attached a one-page MAP and the latest SOW draft for reference.

Summary of next steps (proposed):
- Target close date: 2027-09-20 (contract signed + kickoff scheduled)
- Procurement / signature deadline (internal to Acme): 2027-09-15 - this is the hard cutoff for finance/PO issuance to avoid slipping the implementation window
- Redwood deliverables before signature: final SOW, pricing confirmation, SOC 2 evidence packet (if requested)
- Acme deliverables before signature: procurement POC approval, legal redline turn (2 business days), PO issuance

Assigned owners (first pass):
- Redwood: Vanessa — overall orchestration & DocuSign; Karthik — technical onboarding schedule + ops contact; Ben — pricing & discount approvals
- Acme: Sophie — procurement coordination; Tom Alvarez — security & compliance liaison

Dependencies / blockers we surfaced on the call:
- Finance requires a PO template 10 business days before signature to align with internal payment runs
- Legal may request one clause tweak for data retention (Ben — see note to follow)
- Onboarding window constrained by Acme internal blackout week the week of 2027-09-27 (would push kickoff beyond planned date if signature slips)

Attachments: [Attachment: Redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)], [Attachment: SOW_draft_v3.pdf (pdf)]

Ask for Sophie: please confirm that 2027-09-15 is achievable for your procurement team and flag any additional internal approvals we should loop in. If that date is tight, propose the latest viable signature date and we’ll update the MAP.

I will pause legal/pricing work until Ben confirms whether we can accommodate the small retention clause tweak without extending approvals.

Thanks — I’ll update the MAP once I have your confirmation.

— Vanessa Ortiz
Account Exec, Redwood Inference

Date: Thu, 26 Aug 2027 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Aligning procurement sign-off & target close for Q3 deployment

Vanessa — thanks for the clear recap and the MAP. A few notes from procurement/finance after I ran this by the team: 

- We can commit to a signature target of 2027-09-18 instead of 09-20. Finance requires the PO in our system by 2027-09-16 to make the 9/30 payment run (they need two full business days to validate).
- The 2027-09-15 signature date is tight for our legal — they asked for an extra 48 hours for an initial review if there are redlines; so please assume legal turnaround of up to 2 business days.
- The data retention clause you mentioned is likely to be acceptable with one small edit; I’ve flagged it to Tom for the security review.

Action from Acme: I will confirm with procurement offline and aim to have the PO template to you by 2027-09-01. If we hit any blockers I’ll notify you immediately and propose fallback dates.

Given finance constraints, can you move the MAP signature cutoff to 2027-09-18 and note PO receipt by 2027-09-16 as a milestone? If that works for Redwood, we’re aligned.

Thanks,
Sophie
Senior Procurement Manager, Acme Industrial
s.miller@acmeind.com
